comparison_contract.owner_remap: Compare exact source/output owner relation and references under an explicit whole graph/function/pin alpha map; never equate the two owners or derive identities from coincident scalar values.
comparison_contract.unexpected_outputs: Retain complete Project/descriptor/UDF/signature/input/output/errors/source chains/Float bits/origins before comparison, including unexpected success; no normalization that removes filter/map/order/captures/positions/errors.
comparison_contract.trace: Stage entry/result events frozen; they do not assert every internal node debug-hook event. Native logical errors name their first specific envelope, full error implementation/formatter originals must be retained later.
comparison_contract.materializer: Prospective and UNRUN. Build exactly one descriptor site per recipe, inserting the consumer node once; descriptive duplicate descriptor literals in this JSON are not separate Project owners.
